plain: To work for or against something; to count as a reason for or against

webster.text: To militate against, is to oppose; to be or to act in opposition.

example.quote: There are regulations in different states which are unfavorable to the inhabitants of other states, and which militate against the revenue.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
